prs.cluster_pick_reason: 1996 introduces a dedicated `acceptsMediaType()` helper that does spec-correct Accept-header parsing: it splits on commas/semicolons, checks for `q=0` (explicit rejection) and matches type/subtype including wildcards. 2046's fix instead does a direct `acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')`-style substring check inline, which is prone to false positives (e.g. matching `application/json-patch+json` or `application/foo+json`) and doesn't honor `q=0` exclusion. 1996's factored helper is also independently testable and less likely to regress the `text/event-stream` streaming path.

clusters.pick_reason: 1996 introduces a dedicated `acceptsMediaType()` helper that does spec-correct Accept-header parsing: it splits on commas/semicolons, checks for `q=0` (explicit rejection) and matches type/subtype including wildcards. 2046's fix instead does a direct `acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')`-style substring check inline, which is prone to false positives (e.g. matching `application/json-patch+json` or `application/foo+json`) and doesn't honor `q=0` exclusion. 1996's factored helper is also independently testable and less likely to regress the `text/event-stream` streaming path.

clusters.pick_reason: #2215 fixes a behavioral bug beyond the cosmetic one: it also updates `shouldAttemptFallback` (~line 1058) to compare pathname against '' instead of '/'. Because `buildWellKnownPath`/`buildDiscoveryUrls` already normalized root pathnames to '' before either PR, the old `pathname === '/'` check never matched, causing an extra unnecessary fallback discovery request on every root-path issuer URL — a common case. #2214 only extends the trailing-slash strip to handle multiple trailing slashes (e.g. '/foo//') in both `buildWellKnownPath` and `buildDiscoveryUrls` — a narrower edge case — and never touches `shouldAttemptFallback`, so merging it alone leaves the redundant-fallback bug in place. #2215's `normalizeDiscoveryPath` helper already applies the same multi-slash regex fix inside `buildWellKnownPath`; only #2214's parallel fix inside `buildDiscoveryUrls` would need to be folded in separately during merge.
